name: Clip A: Clean Pulpit Microphone
description: Solo preacher speaking clearly at the podium with direct microphone feed and low ambient noise.
groundTruthTranscript: Welcome brothers and sisters to our sanctuary worship service today. Open your bibles to the book of Romans chapter eight verse twenty-eight. Let us pray together in faith and unity.
groundTruthTranslation: Bienvenidos hermanos y hermanas a nuestro servicio de adoración en el santuario hoy. Abran sus biblias en el libro de Romanos capítulo ocho versículo veintiocho. Oremos juntos en fe y unidad.

groundTruthSpeakers.text: Welcome brothers and sisters to our sanctuary worship service today. Open your bibles to the book of Romans chapter eight verse twenty-eight. Let us pray together in faith and unity.

name: Clip B: Preacher with Live Keyboard Synth Pad
description: Preacher speaking while warm synthesizer keyboard pads play 280Hz background music underneath.
groundTruthTranscript: God is our refuge and our strength, a very present help in times of trouble. Even in the midst of the storm, His peace surpasses all understanding.
groundTruthTranslation: Dios es nuestro refugio y nuestra fortaleza, nuestro pronto auxilio en las tribulaciones. Incluso en medio de la tormenta, su paz sobrepasa todo entendimiento.

groundTruthSpeakers.text: God is our refuge and our strength, a very present help in times of trouble. Even in the midst of the storm, His peace surpasses all understanding.

name: Clip C: Alternating Preacher and Stage Interpreter
description: Preacher speaking in English and stage interpreter immediately repeating the phrase in Spanish in real-time.
groundTruthTranscript: The Lord is good all the time. El Señor es bueno todo el tiempo. And all the time, God is good. Y todo el tiempo, Dios es bueno.
groundTruthTranslation: El Señor es bueno todo el tiempo. The Lord is good all the time. Y todo el tiempo, Dios es bueno. And all the time, God is good.

And all the time, God is good.
